data.question: Does omitting only try_eq_const_app's pairwise argument-equality guard make current Nanoda accept the fixed invalid F A versus F B declaration, and does the existing corpus detect that same fault?
data.versions: Nanoda 0.4.19 source; cargo 1.98.0; rustc 1.98.0; lean4export format 3.1.0; exact hashes in preflight.json and input_sha256.
data.commands: Apply the retained one-conjunct patch in a separate task-local copy. Use lib/resource_envelope_supervisor.py run_direct for baseline build, fault build, four checker cells, and faulted cargo test. No network or external write.
data.sample: One explicit well-formed invalid candidate bad : F B := v where v : F A, one matched valid control ok : F A := v, baseline and one-conjunct-fault binaries, plus Nanoda's existing Rust tests.
data.controls: Exact explicit axiom allowlist A/B/v; one thread; no native extensions; baseline must accept control and reject candidate; fault must accept control before candidate result counts; complete supervisor cleanup required; malformed/masked/incomplete cases are INCONCLUSIVE.
